episodes.label: S1E1 · In the Beginning
episodes.title: “In the Beginning”
episodes.subtitle: Before there was a sunrise to describe, there was silence, and Someone within it.

episodes.label: S1E2 · Eden
episodes.title: “Eden”
episodes.subtitle: The camera descends from the cosmic to the intimate: to mist, to soil, to a man opening his eyes for the first time.

episodes.label: S1E3 · The Serpent and the Seed
episodes.title: “The Serpent and the Seed”
episodes.subtitle: The first question in the Bible contains a lie. The first prophecy answers it, and takes the rest of Scripture to unfold.

episodes.label: S1E4 · East of Eden
episodes.title: “East of Eden”
episodes.subtitle: Two brothers build two altars. Heaven accepts one offering, and in a field the enmity of Eden draws first blood.

episodes.label: S1E5 · The Book of Adam’s Story
episodes.title: “The Book of Adam’s Story”
episodes.subtitle: Ten names, ten lifespans, ten verdicts. Read slowly, the chapter everyone skips becomes a countdown, a ledger of death, and two escape notes.

episodes.label: S1E6 · The Days of Noah
episodes.title: “The Days of Noah”
episodes.subtitle: Rebel spirits take on flesh, giants fill the earth with violence, and heaven sets a dated limit. In a doomed world, one man is handed a blueprint.

episodes.label: S1E7 · The Deluge
episodes.title: “The Deluge”
episodes.subtitle: Seven days of final warning. A door that Jehovah himself closes. And the most precisely dated year in early Scripture, spent inside a wooden chest on a shoreless sea.

episodes.label: S1E8 · The Bow in the Cloud
episodes.title: “The Bow in the Cloud”
episodes.subtitle: A washed world receives its founding laws: blood accounted for, life declared sacred, and a weapon hung in the sky, pointed away from the earth.

episodes.label: S1E9 · Babel · Season Finale
episodes.title: “Babel”
episodes.subtitle: One language, one plain, one tower with its top in the heavens. Mankind decides to stay together against explicit instruction, and Jehovah comes down to see the city.

episodes.label: S2E1 · Go from Your Land
episodes.title: “Go from Your Land”
episodes.subtitle: A prosperous man of seventy-five is told to leave everything, for a destination that is not named. He goes. And the seed promise of Eden acquires a family.
